name: TravelDataEstimator
summary: Estimate how much mobile data a trip will use and the smallest eSIM or roaming plan that covers it.
description: TravelDataEstimator takes the length of a trip and a daily routine (light, typical or heavy profile, or your own mix of maps, browsing, calls, music and video) and returns data use per day, the trip total, a buffered total and the smallest common plan size (1 to 50 GB) that covers it. Rates come from published Netflix, Spotify, Zoom and HTTP Archive figures. Single file, no dependencies, no network calls.
